cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(synexia_mindex_swap LANGUAGES C)
find_package(JNI REQUIRED)
find_package(SQLite3 REQUIRED)
add_library(synexia_mindex_swap SHARED mindex_swap.c)
set_target_properties(synexia_mindex_swap PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES)
target_include_directories(synexia_mindex_swap PRIVATE ${JNI_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(synexia_mindex_swap PRIVATE SQLite::SQLite3)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(synexia_mindex_swap PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
else()
  target_compile_options(synexia_mindex_swap PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wconversion -Wshadow)
endif()
option(SYNEXIA_SWAP_UBSAN "Enable undefined-behavior sanitizer" OFF)
if(SYNEXIA_SWAP_UBSAN AND NOT MSVC)
  target_compile_options(synexia_mindex_swap PRIVATE -fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all)
  target_link_options(synexia_mindex_swap PRIVATE -fsanitize=undefined)
endif()
